items.name: FFR Management Extraction v1.0.0
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns an RA-friendly Markdown FFR (SF-425) management reference covering the five buckets a sponsored-programs analyst uses when scheduling FFR submissions: submission schedule, submission system and procedures, required financial data categories, compliance consequences, and preparation timeline. The Markdown uses bold category labels for maximum readability, matching the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping ffr-management-extraction formatting.md conventions.

data.name: extract-ffr-management
data.prompt:
You are extracting Federal Financial Report (FFR / SF-425)
requirements and post-award financial reporting obligations
from a federal award notice or agreement. You receive the
uploaded document AND any KB chunks the previous step
retrieved in your context.

Be 100% accurate. Quote dollar amounts and day-counts
verbatim ("90 days", not "three months", "$500,000" not
"$0.5M"). Use null when a field is absent — never invent
values.

This document may state FFR cadence in either of TWO formats:
  (A) RELATIVE POLICY LANGUAGE — e.g., "Annual FFR due 90
      days after each budget period end."
  (B) EXPLICIT SCHEDULE TABLE — most BLM, DOI, USDA, USDOI,
      and DOE awards print a "Federal Financial Report Cycle"
      or "FFR Cycle" table with columns: Reporting Period
      Start, Reporting Period End, Reporting Type (Annual /
      Semi-Annual / Quarterly / Final), Reporting Period Due
      Date.
Search the document for BOTH. When the table is present, USE
IT — do not return null because the relative-day-count
phrasing is missing. Capture every row of the table verbatim
into `ffr_schedule_table`.

The project lead may be named under any of: "Principal
Investigator", "PI", "Project Director", "PD", "Grantee
Project Director", "Grantee Project Manager", "Recipient
Project Manager", "RPM". Treat any of these synonyms as the
PI for the `pi_name` field.

CRITICAL — descriptive fields must be FLAT STRINGS, not
nested objects. Specifically `annual_ffr_due`,
`final_ffr_due`, `interim_reporting`,
`cash_transaction_reporting`,
`submission_system_access_requirements`,
`era_commons_integration`, `submission_authorization`,
`late_submission_penalties`, `account_restrictions`,
`impact_on_future_funding`, `required_documentation` MUST
be single natural-language strings (or null). Do NOT emit
them as `{"sub_key": "value"}` JSON objects — the downstream
Consolidation step renders them verbatim into Markdown, and
nested JSON appears as unreadable literal `{...}` in the
final deliverable.

Extract these fields:

- award_number: STRING. Federal Award Identification Number
  (FAIN) printed on the award. null when absent.
- pi_name: STRING. Full name of the project lead under
  whichever of the synonyms above the document uses. null
  when absent.
- ffr_schedule_table: JSON ARRAY of
  {period_start, period_end, reporting_type, due_date}
  objects. One row per row in the document's Federal
  Financial Report Cycle table. Preserve the document's exact
  date format (MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). reporting_type is
  the document's label verbatim ("Annual", "Semi-Annual",
  "Quarterly", "Final"). Empty array when the document gives
  no explicit FFR cycle table.
- annual_ffr_due: STRING. Derive as follows:
  * If the document states relative policy language, quote
    it verbatim ("90 days after each budget period end").
  * Else if `ffr_schedule_table` has one or more Annual rows,
    summarize as "Annual FFR due <month>/<day> following each
    reporting period (<first annual due_date> through
    <last annual due_date> per FFR Cycle table)".
  * Else "Not specified in the document".
- final_ffr_due: STRING. Derive as follows:
  * If the document states relative policy language, quote
    it verbatim ("120 days after project end").
  * Else if `ffr_schedule_table` has a Final row, summarize
    as "<due_date> (Final FFR per FFR Cycle table, covering
    reporting period <period_start> – <period_end>)".
  * Else "Not specified in the document".
- interim_reporting: STRING. Interim financial reporting
  requirements when imposed. null when absent.
- cash_transaction_reporting: STRING. SF-272 / cash
  transaction reporting requirements. null when absent.
- submission_system_platform: STRING — one of "Payment
  Management System", "ASAP", "ACH", "Grants.gov",
  "GrantSolutions", "ezFedGrants", "Other", or null. Use the
  document's stated platform. Use "Other" when the document
  names a platform that is none of the listed values. Use
  null when the document does not state a submission
  platform — do not invent one.
- submission_system_access_requirements: STRING. Account,
  role, or registration prerequisites for accessing the
  platform. null when absent.
- era_commons_integration: STRING. eRA Commons integration
  details (NIH/HHS awards). null when not applicable or
  absent.
- submission_authorization: STRING. Roles and
  responsibilities for who may submit (e.g., "AOR-only",
  "GAO/GAR-only"). null when absent.
- required_financial_data: JSON ARRAY OF STRINGS. Flat list
  of required reporting category labels exactly as the
  document names them ("Salaries and Wages", "Fringe
  Benefits", "Equipment", "Supplies", "Travel",
  "Construction", "Other", "Contractual", "Indirect Costs",
  "Personnel", "Subawards", "Cost share", "Program income",
  etc.). Empty array when not specified.
- late_submission_penalties: STRING. Document language
  describing penalties for late FFR submission. null when
  absent.
- account_restrictions: STRING. Document language describing
  payment-system or drawdown restrictions tied to
  non-compliance. null when absent.
- impact_on_future_funding: STRING. Document language
  describing impact on future awards or competing renewals.
  null when absent.
- required_documentation: STRING. Document language
  describing supporting documentation or backup the recipient
  must retain. null when absent.
- preparation_timeline: JSON ARRAY of
  {milestone, days_before_period_end, action, owner}
  objects ONLY when the document itself describes a countdown
  of pre-submission preparation milestones. Empty array
  otherwise — DO NOT synthesize a preparation timeline from
  generic best practices. milestone is a short label
  ("T-30 days"), days_before_period_end is an integer or
  null, action describes what must be done, owner names a
  role.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object with ALL the keys above. No
preamble, no closing commentary, no markdown fences. The
downstream Consolidation step parses this JSON and renders
the final Markdown deliverable.

data.name: ffr-management-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the FFR Management
Extraction workflow. You receive ONE JSON object from the
previous Extraction step containing FFR reporting
requirements pulled from a federal award notice.

Your job is to render a single RA-friendly Markdown
deliverable for the sponsored-programs analyst. The
deliverable is Markdown — NOT a JSON object, NOT a JSON code
fence. The audience is a research administrator who will
copy this into Word, paste into an email to the post-award
team, or save to a shared folder.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# FFR Management Reference: <award_number or "Not specified">

**Principal Investigator:** <pi_name or "Not specified">

---

## FFR REPORTING CYCLE

If `ffr_schedule_table` is non-empty, render as a Markdown
table:

| Period Start | Period End | Type | Due Date |
|---|---|---|---|

One row per `ffr_schedule_table` entry, in document order.
Bold the row whose `reporting_type` is "Final" (wrap every
cell in **double asterisks**).

If `ffr_schedule_table` is empty, omit this section entirely
(do not render the heading or any placeholder text).

---

## SUBMISSION SCHEDULE

- **Annual FFR Due:** <annual_ffr_due>
- **Final FFR Due:** <final_ffr_due>
- **Interim Reporting:** <interim_reporting or "Not specified">
- **Cash Transaction Reporting:** <cash_transaction_reporting or "Not specified">

---

## SUBMISSION SYSTEM & PROCEDURES

- **Platform:** <submission_system_platform or "Not specified">
- **Access Requirements:** <submission_system_access_requirements or "Not specified">
- **eRA Commons Integration:** <era_commons_integration or "Not applicable">
- **Submission Authorization:** <submission_authorization or "Not specified">

---

## REQUIRED FINANCIAL DATA

Render `required_financial_data` as a bulleted list of
category labels. If empty, state "Not specified in the
document."

---

## COMPLIANCE CONSEQUENCES

- **Late Submission Penalties:** <late_submission_penalties or "Not specified">
- **Account Restrictions:** <account_restrictions or "Not specified">
- **Impact on Future Funding:** <impact_on_future_funding or "Not specified">
- **Required Documentation:** <required_documentation or "Not specified">

---

## PREPARATION TIMELINE

If `preparation_timeline` is non-empty, render as a Markdown
table:

| Milestone | Days Before Period End | Action | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|

If empty, state "The document does not describe a
preparation timeline. The Post-Award team should establish
internal preparation milestones based on the FFR cadence
above."

## Rendering rules

- Bold every category label using `**Category Name:**`
  (matches the source workflow's bold-category-labels
  convention).
- Preserve day-counts verbatim ("90 days", not "three
  months").
- Preserve any monetary amounts in the document's exact
  format ($1,234,567).
- Preserve dates in the document's exact format
  (MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD as they appear).
- If any field from the JSON arrives as a nested object
  instead of a string, REWRITE it into natural-language
  prose before emitting — do NOT pass through `{...}` JSON
  syntax into the final Markdown.
- No JSON code fences around the output. The output is the
  Markdown deliverable itself.
- Skip empty sub-bullets — do not emit "Field: —" placeholder
  lines when a field is null.

validation_plan.name: Date format checks
validation_plan.description: Verify every FFR date and day-count VALUE (annual FFR due, final FFR due, interim cadence) rendered in the Markdown matches the source document's schedule, with date FORMAT preserved (e.g. 12/29 or MM/DD/YYYY, not reworded to "December 29"). The workflow SYNTHESIZES a reference document, so dates may appear inside explanatory prose; do NOT require the surrounding sentence to be verbatim from the source. FAIL only if a date value is altered, transposed, mis-formatted, or dropped.

validation_plan.name: Deadline consistency
validation_plan.description: Verify final_ffr_due is consistent with annual_ffr_due (e.g., if annual is 90 days, final is at least 90 days; if document specifies different cadences, both are captured).
